name: invoice-rounding
title: Exact money rounding
prompt:
Invoice totals in `invoice.py` are sometimes off by one cent. Fix the money handling:
- use `decimal.Decimal` everywhere and round with `ROUND_HALF_UP` to 2 decimals
- each line total (quantity × unit price × (1 + VAT rate)) is rounded to cents BEFORE summing
- inputs may be `int`, `float`, `str` or `Decimal`; convert floats through `str()` (so `0.1` means 0.1)
- both functions return `Decimal`
